en: Colorized postcard view of a small historic town nestled among trees. Red-tiled roofs and several multi-story buildings fill a valley-like setting. In the center foreground is a gabled building with signage, and a courtyard with a few small human figures. The image is framed by lush green foliage. At the top of the image, printed in red text, is the caption 'Meißen. Winkelkrug.' indicating the location.
